# 0.2.0
The first public release of Agentic Developer Kitchen: notes, AI chat, terminals, a browser and your project's files, in a menu bar app with no Dock icon.
- **Project windows** — split a window into File Browser, Document, Notes, Terminal and Browser panes. Tabs, the split layout and each pane's state come back exactly as you left them. - **Notes** — an Apple Notes-style browser over a local markdown note store, plus **Quick Note**, a small floating window for capturing a thought from the menu bar. - **AI chat** — a chat panel for talking with an AI assistant, ready to use without extra setup. - **Terminals** — terminal panes inside your project windows, private terminals, and Terminal Chat for talking with an AI in a terminal pane. - **ADTerminal** — a terminal-only companion app with multipane windows and tab cards. - **Files and documents** — browse a project's files and open them in a tabbed Document pane with side-by-side editors. - **Built-in browser** — a web browser pane that remembers the page it was on. Local AI tools such as Claude Code can drive it through a local MCP server, which you switch on in Settings › Automation. - **Git at a glance** — the current branch and status show in your project windows. - **VS Code extensions** — install extensions from Open VSX and use their webviews and tree views. - **Themes** — pick a theme in Settings or design your own in the full theme editor. - **Searchable settings** — a System Settings-style window with help alongside each panel, and a first-launch walkthrough for the permissions the app needs. - **Automatic updates** — new versions are signed, notarized and installed through the built-in updater.
